desc: Initial attempt with incorrect sweep formula (overcounted due to shared turning points)
Derive the correct O(n) cost formula for minimum moves via edge-crossing flow recurrence

Implement check(T) using edge-crossing recurrence: c_0 = 2f[0] - 1 - [e==0], c_i = 2f[i] - c_{i-1} - [e==i], with final consistency check 2f[n-1] == c[n-2] + (1 if e==n-1 else 0); try candidates e at f-boundaries, 0, n-1
Implement binary search on T in [0, max(points)*m] calling check(mid)
Test on given examples: points=[2,4],m=3→4 and points=[1,2,3],m=5→2
